claim_one_line: RHO IS BUILT: Proposition (2880) and the coupling law stop being certificates about a matrix the paper never writes down. Scope (2880) states that 'rho's structure constants are specified in the source computation and ARE NOT RECONSTRUCTED IN THIS PAPER, so Proposition (2880) is a certificate whose ambient representation is cited rather than rebuilt here.' This builds it from the Kac-Peterson data alone. SU(3) at level 2: dual Coxeter 3, k+g = 5, c = 16/5; the six integrable weights are the (a,b) with a+b <= 2; the inverse Cartan matrix of A2 gives h = (a^2+b^2+ab+3a+3b)/15 and c/24 = 2/15, so the six T entries are zeta_15^13, ^2, ^8, ^2, ^7, ^8 and ORD T = 15 -- the paper's value, derived. S is the Kac-Peterson Weyl sum. Everything lands in Q(zeta_60), the field the paper's own proof names, evaluated at primes p = 1 mod 60 so the arithmetic is exact in F_p. CONTROLS FIRST, and they are what make this rho rather than some other matrix: T^15 = I, S^4 = I, S^2 = C (charge conjugation) and (ST)^3 = S^2, all four at every prime. RESULTS: |<rho(R), rho(L)>| = 2880 = |2T x 2I| at all four primes; theta IS charge conjugation (a,b) -> (b,a), with 2 fixed weights and 2 swapped pairs giving eigenspaces of dimensions 4 and 2, commuting with the whole image so the eigenspaces are invariant and every element is block-diagonal; the 2-dimensional theta = -1 block has image of order 360 -- the value Scope (2880) gives for 2I x Z/3, so the 360-versus-2880 distinction that scope exists to draw is reproduced -- while the 4-dimensional block's image has order 1440; and there are 63 = 7 x 9 conjugacy classes with an EXACT class-by-class match of (class size, chi(A)trV2(B), trV2(A)trV2(B)) against an independently built quaternion model of 2T x 2I (the 24 Hurwitz units and the 120 icosians, chi the order-3 character of 2T with kernel the order-8 Q8). So the coupling law holds as stated and both statements now rest on a representation that exists in the source. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE PAPER: Scope (2880)'s 'are not reconstructed in this paper' can go, with the qualification that Prop (2880) is 'a certificate whose ambient representation is cited rather than rebuilt'. SCOPE: the group order and the class match are enumerations at primes p = 1 mod 60, which is the method the paper itself describes ('enumeration at two unramified primes together with a Serre injectivity argument'), here at four. Nothing about the member, the class, the sisters or the rows; Gate 5 untouched.
